tasks.short: Analyze technology trends and commercial data to recommend markets for product development or sales growth.

steps.what: Agree market questions, comparison periods and commercial success criteria.
Retrieve sales, margin and market series from {BI}, {CRM} and {ERP}.
Read {OTHER} research feeds and save cited technology extracts in {DOCS}.

loop.input: Licensed technology publications, analysis scope and extraction schema.
loop.output: Dated claims, technology categories, source passages and source references.
loop.check: Require a matching source passage for each claim; analyst reviews relevance and unsupported claims.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair per publication; unreadable or unsupported material goes to the analyst.
loop.why_not_simpler: Dates and identifiers follow rules, but technology claims appear in varied prose.

steps.what: Align market categories, currencies and periods in {SPREADSHEET}; reconcile totals.
Compare growth, adoption and margins in {BI}; identify credible signals and limitations.
Assess market attractiveness, strategic fit and alternative explanations.
Draft the market brief in {DOCS}, linking recommendations to charts and sources.

loop.input: Analyst recommendation, approved findings, source references and brief template.
loop.output: Draft market brief with evidence links and explicit assumptions.
loop.check: Insert figures deterministically; verify references; analyst checks interpretation and removes unsupported claims.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass; unresolved passages remain flagged for manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates assemble charts, but explaining different technology signals requires limited prose drafting.

steps.what: Challenge recommendations, approve the brief and select follow-up investigations.

tasks.design: Configure scheduled extracts from {CRM}, {ERP} and {BI}; deterministic jobs on {DATA_PLATFORM} reconcile periods, currencies and market mappings before refreshing {BI}. A bounded extraction loop builds a cited evidence register in {DOCS}, while a separate drafting loop combines approved findings with the analyst's recommendation. Record investigation decisions in {PROJECT} after the finance manager approves the brief.
tasks.previous_blocker: Commercial data and technology evidence used different categories and refresh cycles. Reusable reconciliation rules and reliable source links required substantial setup.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing connectors and scheduled reporting handle much of the data flow. AI-assisted coding can reduce implementation effort, while bounded models can extract and draft prose; neither removes the need for sound market definitions.
tasks.still_hard: Market coverage is uneven, adoption measures lag and technology publicity can resemble demand. Strategic fit and commercial causality remain judgement calls.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge whether a visible trend creates profitable demand, identify missing evidence and choose a useful market experiment.

ambition.what: Market experiment scorecards linking technology signals to testable adoption and margin assumptions.

tasks.altitude: The analyst spends less time assembling extracts and briefs, and more time testing commercial assumptions. They gain discretion to prioritise follow-up investigations within an agreed scope; investment approval stays with the finance manager.

reach.task: Estimate the cost and expected contribution of a proposed market experiment.
reach.learn: Driver-based budgets, contribution margins and sensitivity analysis.

reach.task: Compare investment options arising from the market recommendation.
reach.learn: Scenario valuation, uncertainty ranges and investment hurdle criteria.

evidence.claim: Configured refresh, subscriptions and prepared measures support recurring BI reporting.
Copilot in Power BI supports questions and report creation, but depends on a prepared semantic model.
AI/BI Genie uses trusted assets and example SQL to constrain answers over governed data.
Uber documented faster query drafting and continued invented-table errors, supporting validation rather than unattended querying.
Technology evidence extraction and market-brief drafting are proposed bounded applications, not documented outcomes for this task.
EU AI Act Article 4 establishes AI literacy obligations relevant to rollout.

assumptions: Time shares and remaining time are planning estimates, not measured results.
Structured commercial data dominates, but interpreting technology developments also requires publications; this differs from the fully structured input prior.
Existing {BI} connectors can retrieve the main commercial datasets.
The first release covers an agreed market taxonomy and a limited set of licensed sources.
Analysis uses aggregated commercial data. GDPR applies wherever personal data enters the flow.
Access estimates include source permissions, privacy review and any employee consultation required under national rules. Individual employee performance monitoring is outside the assumed scope.
EU AI Act obligations depend on intended use; rollout includes appropriate AI literacy.
unknowns: Which commercial datasets, connectors and refresh permissions are available?
Are market categories, currency rules and margin definitions already agreed?
Which research subscriptions permit automated processing and storage?
Who approves market briefs and sets investigation spending limits?
Does the actual data include personal data or trigger consultation under national rules?
How much time currently goes to reconciliation versus commercial interpretation?
research_questions: Which observable technology indicators predict purchasing or adoption in the target markets?
Which independent sources can corroborate supplier claims?
What historical benchmarks distinguish sustained growth from publicity spikes?
new_work: Review extracted claims and their source passages.
Resolve unmapped markets, stale feeds and reconciliation exceptions.
Maintain mappings, measure definitions, source permissions and connector credentials.
Check draft interpretations against approved findings.
Track whether recommended experiments confirm or reject the stated assumptions.

role.altitude: The role shifts toward commercial investigation and evidence quality. The analyst can prioritise scoped research, while managers retain investment decisions.
reach: Budget analysts: cost market experiments and test contribution assumptions.
Financial and investment analysts: compare investment scenarios from market findings.
skills_to_grow: Market taxonomy and semantic measure design
role.ambitious_version: Run a recurring market experiment scorecard service that connects technology evidence, commercial performance and investment assumptions.
